candidate.title: Road Work - Como Lake Avenue between Clarke Road and North Road

evidence.readerImpact: Drivers using Como Lake Avenue between Clarke Road and North Road should expect one lane in each direction during daytime BC Hydro utility work.
evidence.freshnessEvidence: City of Coquitlam notice posted July 27, 2026; work starts Wednesday, July 29, 2026.
evidence.uniqueAngleEvidence: No published Trends Today article covers the Como Lake Avenue Clarke-to-North Road work window; existing Coquitlam road-work articles cover different locations.
primaryFacts: BC Hydro utility work is scheduled on Como Lake Avenue between Clarke Road and North Road.
The work window is Wednesday, July 29 to Friday, August 7, excluding Sunday, August 2 and Monday, August 3.
Active work is listed from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
Traffic will be limited to one lane in each direction during active construction.
The city advises drivers to plan an alternate route or extra time and to obey traffic personnel, signs, and construction speed limits.
